subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: When invoked against an existing ungated record, the skill shall resume from it — reloading destination, rulings, facts, and fog — and shall not re-ask any question whose ruling the record already holds.
rationale: the record is the durable session state; context windows are not
fit_criterion: on a kill-and-resume fixture, zero questions from the record's decisions section are re-asked
